paragraphs: My Hobby, by Leo. I am Leo, and I am in Teacher Kim's class. My hobby is chess, and my pieces are not cartoons! A chess game has a board and sixteen pieces for each player. I play every Saturday afternoon with my grandma. I love it.

My grandma has old chess pieces made of wood. The king is the tallest piece. She keeps them in a small red box. The set was expensive when she bought it. I move each piece slowly, because I am careful with it. My grandma taught me the game when I was eight. She is amazing, and she moves her pieces fast. She says "Checkmate!" with a small smile.

We play with a clock, so the game is a race. Each player has five minutes. I try to be quick. If I think for a long time, my clock runs. If my time ends, I lose the game. I have never won a game with her. But I want to win one day. Last Saturday, we played two games. "You are getting better, Leo," said my grandma. I have already played three games with her this month. After each game, she gives me a cold drink and a piece of fruit.

On Sunday, I watch a chess video on my laptop. It helps me prepare for the next game. I watch, and I learn. In one video, two players play on an enormous board in a park. The pieces are as big as children! Many people watch from the grass, and they are very quiet. I want to play on a board like that one day. I also draw cartoons of the chess pieces for the blog.
Have you ever played chess? Which game do you play at home? Write to me, and I will show you one move!
text.summary: Leo writes a page for Explorers' Blog about his hobby, which is chess. He plays with his grandma on Saturday, plays against a clock, and watches a chess video on Sunday.
